text: Hello, Mai. What seems to be the problem?
Hi, doctor. I've been feeling very tired and stressed lately.
I see. Are you sleeping well?
Not really. I often stay up late studying for exams.
That's not good for your health. You need to get enough sleep, at least eight hours a night.
I know, but I have so much homework.
You should try to manage your time better. Also, make sure you eat healthy food and get some exercise.
